programs.showName: King Xian's Worm Valley of Ghost Blowing Lamp
programs.description: Hu Bayi, Wang Kaixuan, and Shiely Yang seek King Xian's tomb to secure the Haochen Bead and break a curse. Meanwhile, perilous dangers and beasts loom.
A village community is left reeling from the brutality of a series of mysterious killings, leading a renowned detective of the era to investigate in search of the truth.
Samson, a Hebrew with extraordinary strength, must use his God-given gift to rally his people to freedom from the evil Philistines.
A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors is played sequentially.
Logan, a former mutant mercenary, lives a peaceful life, void of violence, with his girlfriend Kayla. But, when Kayla is brutally murdered by someone from his past, he decides to seek vengeance.
The Eternals, a race of immortal beings who possess superpowers, secretly live on Earth for thousands of years. However, they must answer evil's call and reunite to defeat the powerful Deviants.
The Fire Nation wreaks havoc on the peaceful coexistence of Air, Water, Earth and Fire nations. A young successor Aang must master all four elements to bring an end to decades of destruction.

programs.showName: Dora and the Lost City of Gold
programs.description: While searching for a hidden land, the parents of a teenage Dora go missing. Consequently, she and her new high-school friends go in search of the lost city of gold with hopes of finding her parents.
After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat together where they must learn to trust each other to survive.

programs.showName: Journey to the West: The Demons Strike Back
programs.description: Tang Sanzang, a monk and his three disciples strive to overcome multiple challenges and fight monsters during the course of their journey.
On a day like no other, the wealthy Cotwell couple's baby boy scrambles unaccompanied across the bustling cityscapes of Chicago, with three slow-witted kidnappers on his tail.
Chaos erupt and multiple lives are endangered when the RMS Titanic, a supposedly unsinkable ship, crashes against an iceberg in the Atlantic Ocean.

Michael Nantz, a Marine staff sergeant, renders his services again, soon after his retirement. He and his platoon have to save the city of Los Angeles from alien invaders.
In the aftermath of a galactic war that shattered the moon and shifted Earth's poles, a massive spaceship named 'Cosmoball' hovers ominously above the planet.
In search of a curse breaker, tomb raider Hu Bayi and his team set out to look for the lost tomb of Emperor Xian on a monster-infested island.
Jake, who has paraplegia, replaces his twin on the Na'vi-inhabited Pandora for a corporate mission. After the natives accept him as one of their own, he must decide where his loyalties lie.
Scrat accidentally sets off an asteroid to Earth while trying to get his acorn. However, Manny, Sid and Diego join forces with Buck to prevent the asteroid from wiping out their existence.
After a genetically altered spider bites him, Peter Parker develops superhuman abilities and confronts a humanoid reptilian creature.
After years of being at odds with each other, the birds and the pigs are forced to work together when a common enemy attempts to drive them away from their homes.
The Avengers and their allies set out to stop Thanos, an alien warlord, from acquiring the Infinity Stones as he plans to eliminate half of all life from the universe using them.

programs.showName: Blood Lake: Attack of the Killer Lampreys
programs.description: After a small town is attacked by numerous lampreys, an animal control specialist takes on the responsibility to bring the situation under control and protect the people.
Anjanam, who respects all life forms, faces trouble after a rat creates havoc in his house. While he tries to get rid of the rodent, a criminal breaks into his home to find his missing diamonds.
A boy finds himself trapped in a gigantic maze with no memories of his past. However, he must work with other boys like him to escape the maze and discover the truth.

An ancient, powerful mutant awakens and recruits followers to cleanse humanity. Professor X and Raven lead a team of young X-Men to stop Apocalypse and save the world.
John Carter finds himself transported to Mars, where he learns about his superhuman capabilities. Things take a turn when he rescues a princess who is on the run.
Betrayed and exiled from his kingdom, lion cub Simba must figure out how to grow up and take back his royal destiny from his treacherous uncle on the plains of the African savanna.
Shane Wolfe, a Navy SEAL, fails to rescue a government scientist, Howard Plummer, from Serbian rebels. Later, he is assigned to protect Plummer's children from his enemies.
During the Cybertron Civil War, Optimus Prime sends Autobot scout B-127 to Earth to form a base where they can regroup. Later, the scout befriends a girl named Charlie, who names him Bumblebee.

A bull's peaceful existence comes crashing down when the authorities return him to his former captors. With help from a wisecracking goat and three hedgehogs, the giant but gentle bovine must find a way to escape before he meets a famous bullfighter.
A symbiote bonds with Peter Parker, intensifying his abilities and aggression. Now, he must face the challenges that his new powers bring while simultaneously fighting new villains.
Tony Stark, a brilliant inventor, gets kidnapped by terrorists while working on a project overseas. He builds a high-tech armour in order to escape and later uses it to save people.
Mowgli is a boy brought up in the jungle by a pack of wolves. When Shere Khan, a tiger, threatens to kill him, a panther and a bear help him escape his clutches.
A group of circus performers cross paths with a deadly poacher in a rainforest, unaware that he is hunting an anaconda while harbouring sinister motives.
An army sniper, a scientist and a group of fugitives hunt down an aggressive alien called the Predator after it escapes and kidnaps a child with autism.

Retired detective Hercule Poirot attends a seance at an opera singer's residence. However, when one of the guests gets murdered, Poirot is forced to put his retirement on hold to solve the case.

After a military plane crash near a small American town, a giant man-eating snake sets off on a killing spree. The locals must find a way to eliminate the snake with the help of a scientist who can kill it.
A python is determined to exact revenge on a secluded village in the northern Fujian district of China after its altar is desecrated by a dead snake.

programs.showName: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programs.description: Peter, Susan, Edmund and Lucy join Prince Caspian to reclaim Narnia from Miraz's oppressive rule, bring back its lost harmony and rightful heir.
Elsa's quest takes her into a magical forest alongside Anna, Kristoff and Olaf as they unravel secrets about her powers and Arendelle's destiny.
During a mission, Kree warrior Carol Danvers is separated from her team and stranded on Earth. There, she meets S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Nick Fury, who helps uncover her past to end the intergalactic war.
In a city host to a variety of elements, a hot-tempered, fiery Ember meets the emotional, heart-on-his-sleeve Wade. As they navigate precarious situations, their stark differences bring them closer.
The Spengler family must join forces with the original Ghostbusters to stop an ancient evil force from refreezing the world, whilst protecting their iconic New York City firehouse headquarters.
Jean Grey's superpowers magnify after she is struck by solar energy. However, when she is unable to control her capabilities, the X Men strive to rescue her.
Shan, a beautiful mermaid, is sent on a mission to kill Liu Xuan, a business tycoon. However, complications arise when they develop feelings for each other.

Lily Houghton sets out to search for a mystical tree, whose flowers grant immortality. Her party encounters an obstacle in the form of the evil Prince Joachim who also desires the flower for his selfish gains.
Cameron Poe, a wrongly convicted parolee, travels in a flight to go home. However, trouble knocks on the door when the flight is hijacked by some dangerous criminals.

A Kunlun gatekeeper's son forms an alliance with a powerful man, fuelled by the desire to avenge the betrayal suffered by his father.

programs.showName: A Good Day to Die Hard
programs.description: New York City cop John McClane and his estranged son must put aside their differences and work together to get a Russian whistleblower to safety and thwart a disastrous crime in Chernobyl.
Bolt is a dog who stars in a super hit television show in which he possesses superpowers. However, things change when he believes his powers are real and embarks on a purposeful mission.
Manny the mammoth, Sid the loquacious sloth, and Diego the saber-toothed tiger go on a comical quest to return a human baby to his father, across a world on the brink of an ice age.
A shark's encounter with an alien probe turns it into a robotic killer, forcing locals to confront a terrifying threat that blends the natural and technological worlds.
A hard-living superhero who has fallen out of favor with the public enters into a questionable relationship with the wife of the public relations professional who's trying to repair his image.

programs.showName: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
programs.description: The Fantastic Four fight against all odds to defeat a powerful foe, Silver Surfer, and stop him from destroying Earth before it's too late.
A wrathful goddess unleashes a cataclysmic typhoon upon the world as punishment for humanity's transgressions. Panic ensues as people are forced to confront monstrous creatures amid the chaos.

Kidnapped as an infant for her hair's healing powers and hidden away in a tower by a witch, Rapunzel longs to be free. When the kingdom's most-wanted bandit, Flynn Rider, hides in Rapunzel's tower, the feisty teenager strikes a deal with him.
After losing his job, lover and his powers, Peter Parker feels dissatisfied with his life. Soon, amidst all this chaos, he also has to fight Doctor Octavius who poses a threat to the New York.
Lucian, a werewolf slave, convinces his Lycan compatriots to rebel against their vampire masters, who are led by Viktor, a powerful vampire elder. This leads to a full-fledged war between the two.

programs.showName: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
programs.description: Captain Jack Sparrow sets sail in search of the legendary fountain of youth. However, he comes across a woman from his past, an old enemy and a feared pirate in his quest.

Lao Luo and his horse achieve instant worldwide fame through a recorded physical altercation against creditors. This veteran performer and his equine companion gain immense popularity after the intense encounter becomes a trend.

When a team of terrorists threaten to destroy an airport and demand the release of the drug lord Ramon Esperanza, detective John McClane tries to stop them.
Remy, a rat, aspires to become a renowned French chef. However, he fails to realise that people despise rodents and will never enjoy a meal cooked by him.
An enchantress, disguised as an old beggar, curses a selfish prince to live as a beast. To break her spell, he must learn to love and be loved before the last petal of the rose falls.
Armed with the latest high-tech spy equipment, a guinea pig and his highly trained team of rodents are sent on a mission to scupper the plans of a power-hungry billionaire from destroying the world.
Eight-year-old Alex defends his home and outwits inept thieves trying to recover a top-secret computer chip hidden in a toy car, intended to aid a terrorist group.
While attempting to fight off Kree enemies, Captain Marvel finds herself connected to Monica Rambeau and Kamala Khan through their quantum powers.
A man catches a train to Busan with his daughter on her birthday to go see his wife. However, things take a nightmarish turn when a zombie outbreak occurs in South Korea.
Alice, along with her allies, returns to Raccoon City to attack The Hive and stop the Umbrella Corporation from unleashing its final strike on the last remaining survivors of the apocalypse.
Aladdin, a lovable street urchin, teams up with a powerful, wisecracking genie to save the kingdom of Agrabah, and its beautiful princess Jasmine from the evil grand vizier Jafar.
An American historian and his friend embark on a mission to find a ship lost in the Arctic. However, complications arise when their financier turns out to be a criminal mastermind.
Wolverine travels back in time to stop Mystique from assassinating Bolivar Trask, whose death leads to the creation of the Sentinels, robots designed to kill mutants.
